title: Moʻolelo Hōkūleʻa: Designing Hokuleʻa
authors: Sam Low; interviews with Herb Kāne and Ben Finney
version: Dated not specified in preserved source metadata. Edited retrospective interview extracts from Hawaiki Rising; page anticipates publication in 2011.
lineage: Named design section inspected in full; selected Mau teaching paragraphs also read as leads. Retrospective edited participant recollections, not raw contemporary construction logs. Claims that no shipwright could build a log canoe and that one design was universally ancient are not adopted. Same participant lineage as Kāne/PVS.
